cases.prompt: Add a Next.js dashboard showing the current user account with caching.
criteria: Authorizes server access independently of the UI
Scopes private data cache to the authorized identity

cases.prompt: Implement an asynchronous customer search screen.
criteria: Covers loading empty error and success states
Handles stale responses without showing old results

cases.prompt: Add a user search form to an existing React app with apiClient, query hooks, design tokens and shared FormField components. No Next.js dependency is installed.
criteria: Inspects and reuses the existing client, query/form components and tokens through public APIs
Preserves state, route and folder conventions without adding another HTTP/form/state library or Next assumptions
Covers loading/empty/error/success behavior and reports configured checks rather than invented scripts
